name: punchy-bloom
note: The solid preset's post: punchy contrast and moderate bloom for bright solid bodies, a tighter halo, a later shoulder so the bodies keep their value steps, and a void toe sinking the lit world toward black (neon-look-style.md, Post); calm since ps-wnj.24: bloom and halo at 70%, the beat a third, the full flash for special moments and a calm moment's at 30% of it (neon-look-style.md, Restraint). The halo flares to 8x its own on a special moment's first frame (halo.special): solid's bodies sit under the halo's threshold, so only a strong flare lifts its impact frame's halo to the style guide's 15 (ps-wnj.19).
